overall_quality.evidence: One of the most fascinating facts is that the human body contains more bacteria than human cells. This is surprising because we often think of ourselves as being made up of our own cells. However, the bacteria in and on our bodies outnumber our own cells by a factor of 10 to 1. This bacterial community, known as the microbiome, plays a crucial role in our health and well-being.
